paperclipSurface.reason: The old TSBC-980 single-prompt Paperclip smoke universally scored 0.000 for every model and therefore did not discriminate model capability. TSBC-1262 reran the real isolated live-fixture surface and produced non-universal scored rows before halting on agent-auth failure, so the valid Paperclip tool-use measurement now belongs to that fixture harness and TSBC-1141 rather than this bounded Spark pack.
